mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand-driven growth with supply constraints, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (GDPC1 * INDPRO) is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with high housing starts (HOUST > 1300), moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3.0%), and strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 500000), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns as the economy approaches peak activity without triggering aggressive policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for at least 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that typically triggers monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates monetary policy response to economic weakness, which typically leads to positive equity returns as the market anticipates stimulus and avoids recession.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) is not significant (p>0.05) in regression of 20-day returns, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
